faqs.question: What is DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Ang DigiSPES ay isang web-based system na nagdi-digitalize ng Special Program for Employment of Students (SPES) para mas mapabilis at maging mas maayos ang application, examination, at management process.

faqs.question: Ano ang SPES?
faqs.answer: Ang SPES o Special Program for Employment of Students ay isang programa ng DOLE na nagbibigay ng pansamantalang trabaho sa mga estudyante mula sa low-income families.

faqs.question: Sino ang pwedeng gumamit ng DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Maaaring gumamit ng DigiSPES ang SPES applicants, beneficiaries, Municipal PESO staff, at Provincial PESO staff.

faqs.question: Libre ba ang paggamit ng DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Oo, libre ang paggamit ng DigiSPES para sa lahat ng SPES applicants at beneficiaries.

faqs.question: Kailangan ba ng account para makagamit ng DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Oo, kailangan gumawa ng account upang makapag-apply, makapag-exam, at ma-track ang application status.

faqs.question: Paano gumawa ng DigiSPES account?
faqs.answer: I-click ang Register button sa DigiSPES website at punan ang required personal at academic information.

faqs.question: Pwede bang gumamit ng cellphone sa DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Oo, mobile-friendly ang DigiSPES at maaaring gamitin sa cellphone, tablet, o computer.

faqs.question: Anong browser ang recommended?
faqs.answer: Mas mainam gumamit ng updated browsers tulad ng Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, o Mozilla Firefox.

faqs.answer: Karaniwang requirements ay school ID, certificate of enrollment, barangay clearance, at proof of income.

faqs.question: Where can I download my SPES certificate?
faqs.answer: Once your employment period is complete, download from DigiSPES dashboard. / Kapag tapos na ang employment period, i-download sa DigiSPES dashboard.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if SPES certificate has errors?
faqs.answer: Contact your Municipal PESO staff or system admin for corrections. / Makipag-ugnayan sa Municipal PESO o system admin para sa correction.

faqs.question: How do I reset my DigiSPES password?
faqs.answer: Use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page or contact support. / Gamitin ang 'Forgot Password' sa login page o kontakin ang support.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for technical issues with DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Contact the system administrator or IT support via email or hotline. / Makipag-ugnayan sa system admin o IT support via email o hotline.

faqs.question: How can I update my contact information?
faqs.answer: Update it in your account settings on DigiSPES. / I-update sa account settings sa DigiSPES.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if I missed the application deadline?
faqs.answer: Contact your Municipal PESO for guidance on possible extensions. / Makipag-ugnayan sa Municipal PESO para sa extension options.

faqs.question: How do I submit additional documents?
faqs.answer: Upload through your DigiSPES account if the system allows or submit to PESO staff. / I-upload sa DigiSPES account o isumite sa PESO staff.

faqs.question: Who can help if I encounter errors during the online exam?
faqs.answer: Contact the system admin or your Municipal PESO office immediately. / Makipag-ugnayan sa system admin o Municipal PESO agad.

faqs.question: How do I know if I am eligible for SPES?
faqs.answer: Check the eligibility module in DigiSPES or verify with PESO staff. / Tingnan ang eligibility module sa DigiSPES o i-verify sa PESO.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if I want to appeal a rejected application?
faqs.answer: Submit a formal request to your Municipal PESO office. / Mag-submit ng formal request sa Municipal PESO.

faqs.question: How can DigiSPES help me as a student?
faqs.answer: It simplifies the SPES application, examination, and employment tracking process. / Pinapadali nito ang SPES application, exam, at employment tracking para sa mga estudyante.

faqs.question: What should I do if I forget my DigiSPES password?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow instructions, or contact support. / I-click ang 'Forgot Password' sa login page at sundin ang instructions o kontakin ang support.

faqs.question: How do I know when my application is being reviewed?
faqs.answer: Check your dashboard for status updates like 'Under Review'. / Tingnan ang dashboard para sa status tulad ng 'Under Review'.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for help with uploading documents?
faqs.answer: Municipal PESO staff or system admin can assist. / Municipal PESO staff o system admin ang pwedeng makatulong.

faqs.question: Can I apply for SPES online from home?
faqs.answer: Yes, DigiSPES is web-based and accessible anywhere with an internet connection. / Oo, ang DigiSPES ay web-based at puwedeng gamitin kahit saan basta may internet.

faqs.question: What if my internet connection fails during the online exam?
faqs.answer: Contact Municipal PESO immediately to report and request assistance. / Makipag-ugnayan agad sa Municipal PESO para i-report at humingi ng tulong.

faqs.question: How do I check my pending documents?
faqs.answer: Pending documents are listed in your DigiSPES dashboard notifications. / Nakalista ang pending documents sa dashboard notifications.

faqs.question: Who should I contact for questions about SPES eligibility?
faqs.answer: Your Municipal PESO staff is the best contact. / Municipal PESO staff ang pinakamainam na contact.

faqs.question: Can I print my application form?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can download and print the summary from your DigiSPES account. / Oo, puwede i-download at i-print ang application summary sa DigiSPES account.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if I want to update my profile photo?
faqs.answer: Upload through your account or contact PESO for assistance. / I-upload sa account o kontakin ang PESO para sa tulong.

faqs.question: What should I do if my exam link doesn’t work?
faqs.answer: Contact the system admin or PESO IT support immediately. / Makipag-ugnayan agad sa system admin o PESO IT support.

faqs.question: Can I edit my application after submitting?
faqs.answer: No, once submitted, edits are not allowed. Contact PESO for corrections. / Hindi, kapag na-submit na, hindi puwedeng i-edit. Kontakin ang PESO para sa correction.

faqs.question: How do I know my stipend has been approved?
faqs.answer: Check your DigiSPES dashboard and notification email from PESO. / Tingnan sa dashboard at notification email mula sa PESO.

faqs.question: Who should I contact if I have issues with the SPES certificate?
faqs.answer: Municipal PESO staff or system admin can assist. / Municipal PESO staff o system admin ang pwedeng makatulong.

faqs.question: How can I check my work schedule?
faqs.answer: Check your employment assignment section on DigiSPES dashboard. / Tingnan ang employment assignment section sa DigiSPES dashboard.

faqs.question: What should I do if I didn’t receive notifications?
faqs.answer: Contact your Municipal PESO or check your spam/junk email folder. / Kontakin ang Municipal PESO o tingnan ang spam/junk folder ng email.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for problems with salary computation?
faqs.answer: PESO payroll officer or HR officer of your LGU. / Kontakin ang PESO payroll officer o HR officer ng LGU.

faqs.question: How can I submit missing documents after deadline?
faqs.answer: Contact PESO for approval to resubmit. / Makipag-ugnayan sa PESO para sa approval ng resubmission.

faqs.question: Who should I contact for employment conflicts?
faqs.answer: Municipal PESO staff will assist in resolving issues. / Municipal PESO staff ang tutulong sa resolution.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I am under 18 years old?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you need parental consent and meet SPES requirements. / Oo, pero kailangan ng parental consent at SPES eligibility.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for technical errors in DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: System admin or PESO IT support. / System admin o PESO IT support.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I am a part-time student?
faqs.answer: Yes, you are eligible as long as you are currently enrolled. / Oo, eligible basta currently enrolled.

faqs.question: How can I verify my assigned employer?
faqs.answer: Check the employment assignment section on your dashboard. / Tingnan ang employment assignment section sa dashboard.

faqs.question: Who should I contact if my uploaded photo is rejected?
faqs.answer: Contact system admin or Municipal PESO for guidance. / Kontakin ang system admin o Municipal PESO para sa guidance.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule my SPES orientation?
faqs.answer: Contact PESO to request a reschedule. / Makipag-ugnayan sa PESO para mag-request ng reschedule.

faqs.question: How do I know the location of my assigned workplace?
faqs.answer: Check the employment assignment section on DigiSPES dashboard. / Tingnan ang employment assignment section sa dashboard.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if my employment start date is delayed?
faqs.answer: Contact Municipal PESO or your assigned employer. / Makipag-ugnayan sa Municipal PESO o employer.

faqs.question: How can I know if my stipend has been released?
faqs.answer: Check the payroll section on your dashboard or contact PESO payroll officer. / Tingnan ang payroll section sa dashboard o kontakin ang PESO payroll officer.

faqs.question: What should I do if my DigiSPES dashboard shows errors?
faqs.answer: Clear browser cache, refresh the page, or contact system admin. / I-clear ang browser cache, refresh, o kontakin ang system admin.

faqs.question: Who can help me with SPES eligibility questions?
faqs.answer: Municipal PESO staff or your school guidance counselor. / Municipal PESO staff o school guidance counselor.

faqs.question: Can I check my previous SPES applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, all past applications are recorded in your DigiSPES account. / Oo, naka-record lahat ng past applications sa account.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if my DigiSPES account is locked?
faqs.answer: Contact system admin or Municipal PESO to unlock your account. / Kontakin ang system admin o Municipal PESO para i-unlock ang account.

faqs.question: How do I check my pending tasks?
faqs.answer: Pending tasks appear in the dashboard notifications. / Nakalista ang pending tasks sa dashboard notifications.

faqs.question: Can I access DigiSPES on my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, DigiSPES is mobile-friendly. / Oo, mobile-friendly ang DigiSPES.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if notifications are not received?
faqs.answer: Check spam/junk folder or contact Municipal PESO. / Tingnan spam/junk folder o kontakin ang Municipal PESO.

faqs.question: How can I change my contact number in DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Update it in account settings or contact PESO for assistance. / I-update sa account settings o kontakin ang PESO para tulong.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for issues with the online exam platform?
faqs.answer: System admin or Municipal PESO IT support. / System admin o Municipal PESO IT support.

faqs.question: Can I apply for SPES if I have other government aid?
faqs.answer: Yes, disclose other aid in your application. / Oo, i-disclose ang ibang aid sa application.

faqs.question: How do I download DigiSPES reports?
faqs.answer: Reports can be downloaded from your dashboard if permitted. / Puwedeng i-download ang reports sa dashboard kung pinapayagan.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if DigiSPES system is down?
faqs.answer: Contact system admin or Municipal PESO for status updates. / Kontakin ang system admin o Municipal PESO para sa update.

faqs.question: Can I track my employment history in DigiSPES?
faqs.answer: Yes, all assigned jobs are tracked in your account. / Oo, naka-track lahat ng employment sa account.
